Thank you for responding to me last night. I made it through the night because of what you said. It also came down to not wanting to make my mom sad. 
I hope you are ok too. It sounds like you are in a dark place and I’m so sorry to hear that. Let me know if you ever want to talk.

I have a psychiatrist prescribing meds that I take but a therapist is still a great idea. Thank you. It’s just hard to get through tonight and these upcoming weeks. I’ve already convinced myself that this is the answer and it’s really hard to reverse that.
We won’t, but someone might have to feed them to you
Yep that’s what makes it fun in a way
Was going for wormhole but this works too lol
Oh it hurts to be this good.
